text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p95 latency spike on runtime-cluster-usw2 (svc=redwood-runtime, p95 -> 780ms, baseline 120ms)

maria: saw this in dashboards, looks correlated with a short-seq workload spike from tenant T-42

jon: flameprof shows a kernel selection churn - lots of fast short requests falling back to kernel-v3 and triggering KV cache evictions

kevin: wow, KV-cache evictions up 6x over 5m for that shard. eviction rate log: `evict_count=1258, hit_rate=0.42`

angela: can someone post the kernel decision trace? wondering if autoswitch heuristics mis-classified short sequence as longseq path

jon: paste of decision snippet: ```json
{"req_id":"r-9a3","seq_len":8,"chosen_kernel":"kernel-v3-opt","alt":"kernel-v2-short"}```

maria: so autoswitch prefers v3 for certain batch sizes, but v3 is heavy on setup cost for short seqs -> p99 amplification

kevin: mitigation proposal: 1) force kernel fallback for shortseqs via feature flag 2) throttle T-42 to limit burst 3) route new requests to fallback model variant r2-small

angela: agree. I can flip a feature flag for shortseq path to prefer kernel-v2-short. jon can you prepare the flag toggle and deploy?

jon: flipping `runtime.kernel.prefer_shortseq=true` for prod now. running: `ffctl set runtime.kernel.prefer_shortseq=true --env prod --target shard:usw2`

deploy-bot: Feature flag runtime.kernel.prefer_shortseq=true toggled by jon on prod (shard=usw2) at 2103456801

maria: routing change queued: route-rule `tenant:T-42 -> model:r2-small` with fallback to r3 if errors > 1%

kevin: started tenant-level throttle: `token_bucket` limit 120r/s -> validated on canary, applying to node group now

angela: Can we watch effects for 5m and check p95/p99 and KV cache stats? Also send a quick eval on a synthetic shortseq load to ensure no regressions in quality

jon: synthetic test run attached (shortseq=avg 7 tokens): p95=95ms, p99=160ms, KV hit_rate=0.87

maria: dashboards show prod p95 dropping back to ~130ms within 90s of flag flip. eviction rate trending down

sre-bot: Incident update: applied kernel fallback flag + tenant throttle + routing fallback. Monitoring.

kevin: follow-up action items: (1) tweak batching heuristic to factor sequence length variance, (2) add decision-logging at lower sample for 24h, (3) create a regression test in perf-suite for shortseq spikes

angela: I'll own (1) with jon. kevin please add (2) to telemetry backlog. maria handle comms with customer T-42 (FYI & mitigation steps)

maria: pinged T-42 support channel with summary and ETA for permanent solution: 24h

jon: re-enabled autoscale for shard after throttle verification. keeping the flag for 6h, will roll back if we see side effects

deploy-bot: Rollout note: kernel fallback flag scheduled to auto-disable at 2103490401 unless extended manually

sre-bot: closing alert if metrics remain stable for next 10 minutes. :white_check_mark:
